transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. What brings you in today?

I keep losing track of what I’m supposed to be working on and can’t seem to stay organized with all the tickets and follow-ups at my job. It’s gotten really frustrating, and I’m having a hard time keeping up.
Do you often have trouble focusing on tasks, even when you're trying your best, and has this been happening since you were a child?

Yes, I really struggle to stay focused, especially during long troubleshooting calls or classes where my mind just drifts off or gets pulled away by any little distraction. This isn't new, though—even back in elementary school, my teachers wrote notes home about my daydreaming and unfinished worksheets. My parents still joke about how I could never sit still long enough to finish my homework back then.
Have you been feeling down, hopeless, or lost interest in things you used to enjoy, especially over the past few weeks?

No, I haven't really been feeling down or hopeless, and I still enjoy my hobbies like late-night tinkering. My main struggles are really just about trying to stay focused, keeping organized, and managing my constant restlessness at work.
